metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature, observed with MODIS Aqua, in Arizona higher on July 15-21, 2017 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Collection and strategy: MODIS Aqua Land Surface Temperature (LST) product (MYD11A1). Band "LST_Day_1km" in Kelvin. 2. Time window: 7 days (DOY 196–202, ~15–21 July) for 2001-2010 (reference) and for 2017 (target). 3. Region: Arizona state. Use a 30-km buffer around the state centroid to keep computation fast and inside EE limits. 4. Quality masking: Use the “QC_Day” band bits 0–1 keep only 00 (good quality) and 10 (average quality). 5. Check steps sequentially: - If either collection size == 0 → C1 - After masking, total valid-pixel count == 0 → C2 - Compute mean LST for each period. If result is None/NaN/invalid (e.g., LST not within 200–350 K) → C3 - If 2017 mean > 2001-2010 mean → A (Yes), else → B (No) 6. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry (Arizona centroid + 30 km buffer)
az = ee.Feature(ee.FeatureCollection("TIGER/2018/States").filterMetadata("NAME","equals","Arizona").first())
geom = az.geometry().centroid().buffer(30000)

# 2. Helper to build 7-day 2001-2010 average
def lst_mean(year, doy, name):
    start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year,1,1).advance(doy-1,'day')
    col = (ee.ImageCollection("MODIS/006/MYD11A1")
             .filterDate(start, start.advance(7,'day'))
             .select(['LST_Day_1km','QC_Day'], ['LST','QC']))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"{name} Images: 0"); return None
    mask = lambda img: img.select('LST').updateMask(
        img.select('QC').bitwiseAnd(3).lte(2))
    col = col.map(mask)
    mean = (col.mean()
              .multiply(0.02)       # scale to Kelvin
              .subtract(273.15)     # convert to Celsius
              .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                             geometry=geom, scale=3000,
                             maxPixels=1e9))
    val = mean.get('LST')
    pix = col.first().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                   geometry=geom, scale=3000,
                                   maxPixels=1e9).get('LST')
    return val, pix

# build 2001-2010 average
vals = [lst_mean(y,197,'base')[0] for y in range(2001,2011)]
if any(v is None for v in vals):
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    ref_mean = ee.List(vals).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).getInfo()

# 2017 value
tst_val, tst_pix = lst_mean(2017,197,'2017')
if tst_val is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif tst_pix.getInfo() == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    tst_mean = tst_val.getInfo()
    print(f"2017 mean LST: {tst_mean:.2f} °C, Pixels: {int(tst_pix.getInfo())}")
    print(f"Ref avg LST:   {ref_mean:.2f} °C")  # implies decade average
    if tst_mean is None or ref_mean is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif tst_mean > ref_mean:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
